question: Can an action-preserving invertible affine relabeling of public charge bits transfer any unequal J9B paired complete law under the two fixed actions?
fork_classification: After the J9C restricted spatial route closed, a signed/affine public-output transfer is a reversible, zero-Born prerequisite. Test the necessary affine-rank invariant first; if it fails, no expensive search for a map in this family is warranted. Non-bijective operator identities are a separate unresolved branch, not human ranking.

hypotheses.rank_compatible: At least one unequal-law pair has equal affine parity rank and support cardinality, so this necessary condition does not rule out an invertible affine relabeling; operator and held-out-law validation would remain necessary.
hypotheses.rank_obstructed: Every unequal-law pair has different affine parity rank/support cardinality, ruling out invertible affine output maps for the evaluated class only.
hypotheses.censored: J9B source hash, law count, action binding, affine-support identity or CPU bound fails; make no rank-transfer claim.

model_boundary: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 projector/fusion instrument. Use only the 12 frozen deterministic-first J8X error pairs and both fixed relation-free public actions as validated in J9B. Private errors are analysis-only; no new observations or policy choices.

matrix.cells: All 12 error pairs times actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35], including all 18 equal-law and six unequal-law controls.
matrix.test: For each pair/action cell replay J9B affine rank r and active-bit count n, verify complete-law support cardinality equals 2^(n-r), then compare paired ranks. Any invertible affine map on the common active public bits preserves cardinality and rank; unequal ranks are a necessary-condition obstruction, not an operator proof.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact stored pair/action public-law comparison; no sampling uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin the J9B result and runner hash; require 24 cells/48 laws, both actions, 18 null and six positive-TV controls, exact support-rank arithmetic, zero new Born/character/history/arm/bootstrap work.

acceptance: All 24 frozen cells replay the exact affine rank/support-cardinality invariant within the cap
Classify every unequal-law cell as rank-compatible or rank-obstructed without constructing unvalidated maps
Restrict conclusions to evaluated deterministic-first laws and identify non-bijective relation and full-prior mixture as unresolved
stop_rule: Stop at all 24 cells or first pinned-input/integrity/5-CPU-second failure. No map search, new law, first-record enumeration, Born evaluation, histories or budget expansion.
